subject: Merchant BlackFriday 502s — impact window confirmation & credit eligibility
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@ledgerly.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ledgerly Platform Ops <platform-ops@ledgerly.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Checkout failures during BlackFriday window — observed 502s (need SLA confirmation)

Hi Soojin,

We hit a sharp increase in 502 responses on Ledgerly between ~08:58 and ~09:26 PST this morning while our BlackFriday promo was live. Rough numbers from our side: ~11% of checkout attempts returned 502s, roughly 1.2k failed transactions during that 28-minute span. Our finance team flagged this as a material outage for the campaign.

Can you confirm whether Redwood observed a service-level availability gap for our tenant during that window, and whether that qualifies for SLA credit under the contract? We need the official window and an initial eligibility assessment so we can start internal accounting.

Attached: ledgerly-sample-traces.txt (curl traces with timestamps)

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Ops, Ledgerly
alex@ledgerly.com
+1 415-555-0199

----

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>

Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Checkout failures during BlackFriday window — observed 502s (need SLA confirmation)

Alex — thanks for reporting and very sorry you hit this during a priority campaign. I’ve looped in David (SRE) and Laura (your account lead) to coordinate.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- We’ll pull the telemetry and edge logs for Ledgerly for the 08:45–09:40 PST window and return a verified downtime interval.
- David will run an initial triage to identify whether this looks like an infrastructural outage (instance preemption / autoscaler) or something routing/auth-related.
- Laura will follow up on the contractual side to outline likely SLA credit paths; we’ll aim to provide an initial eligibility note within 24 hours.

Could you attach the campaign-impact spreadsheet you mentioned (estimated revenue impact) and any additional traces you collected? That will help us prioritize the postmortem.

We’ll update you by end of day tomorrow with the preliminary window and evidence pack.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai

From: Alex Turner <alex@ledgerly.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ledgerly Platform Ops <platform-ops@ledgerly.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 15:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Checkout failures during BlackFriday window — observed 502s (need SLA confirmation)

Thanks Soojin — attaching more detail.

What I added:
- ledgerly-traces-20261115.json: full request IDs and upstream timestamps (sampled).
- campaign-impact-summary.xlsx: estimates ~ $78k in gross merchandise value affected, with ~420 carts abandoned that we can attribute to 502s.

Observed specifics:
- First 502 spike at 08:58:11 PST; peak 502 rate between 09:04–09:10 PST; tailing off after 09:20 PST.
- All failures started returning 502 (Bad Gateway) from our client logs — we suspect Redwood edge or routing layer but we haven’t ruled out auth/timeouts upstream.

Please include the exact UTC timestamps you verify as the outage window, and whether this is considered a Tenant Availability incident under section 3.2 of our agreement. If eligible, please provide an initial estimate of credit calculation methodology (proportional to impacted minutes or a percentage of monthly invoice) and a timeline for the postmortem.

Alex

Attachments: ledgerly-traces-20261115.json, campaign-impact-summary.xlsx

From: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@ledgerly.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Checkout failures during BlackFriday window — observed 502s (need SLA confirmation)

Alex — quick summary from SRE after preliminary evidence pull. Thanks for the traces and impact sheet, they were helpful.

Verified telemetry: Redwood observed a sharp increase in 502 responses for Ledgerly tenant fingerprints originating in us-west-2 between 2026-11-15T16:58:11Z and 2026-11-15T17:26:30Z (UTC) which corresponds to roughly 08:58–09:26:30 PST as you reported. The spike aligns with an autoscaler churn event on a small pool serving Ledgerly, combined with a transient authorization service cascade that caused upstream backpressure and a proxy 502 surface.

Preliminary classification: Tenant Availability impact (partial) that affected backend success rate for the tenant. We are treating this as an SLA-impacting degradation pending full trace bundle.

Initial credit guidance: per section 3.2 of the SLA, a proportional credit is the expected remedy. Based on the verified 28.3-minute sustained window and the error rate observed for your tenant, an initial estimate is up to 5% of the monthly service fees for the affected billing period (final amount subject to full telemetry reconciliation and invoice-prorating rules). We will not finalize numbers until the billing reconciliation team completes the calculation.

Requested items we will produce or need from you:
- Redwood will prepare and deliver: full raw log bundle (edge+proxy+kvcache) for the 08:45–09:40 PST window, a short timeline slide deck, and a preliminary incident write-up. Expect trace bundle delivery by 2026-11-17 18:00 PST. Link will be shared to the Drive link above.
- Please confirm any additional internal transaction ids you want included in the bundle beyond what you shared; that speeds correlation.

Postmortem timing: We propose a 60-minute postmortem review with your team on 2026-11-18 at 10:00 PST. Agenda: facts, root cause, corrective actions, timelines for mitigation (autoscaler hardening + authz backpressure guardrails). If that works, Laura will send the invite and include a tentative remediation runbook.

Next steps from us: collect final evidence, run the billing calc, and provide a formal SLA entitlement decision and credit computation in the postmortem packet.

Regards,
David Kim
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
david@redwood.ai
